topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I couldn't help but giggle when I finally got the message. It was supposed to be a surprise, but I had a feeling something was up when everyone seemed oddly busy. My friends were trying so hard to keep it a secret, but their attempts at sneaky texts and whispered conversations only made me more curious. When I finally figured out what was going on, I was thrilled to think I’d caught them off guard. But then, the message came—plans had changed. Still, the thought that they went through all that trouble for me just made me appreciate them even more. I can’t wait to see what they come up with next!
